modules.purpose: Python CLI, scanner orchestration, normalization, scoring, storage, and security case generation.
common_changes: Add or tune scanner adapters
Change normalized finding shape
Adjust severity scoring or case grouping
Update CLI flags or scan profiles

modules.purpose: Local HTTP dashboard server and API routing layer plus Honey Key endpoints and background scan jobs. Three concerns were split out into sibling modules: the /api/summary payload assembly lives in dashboard_payload.py, the server-rendered /report/ and /docs/ pages live in dashboard_pages.py, and the scan pipeline (scan_repo) lives in scan_orchestrator.py. Edit those modules for payload/page/scan behavior; this file routes requests to them.
common_changes: Add or route dashboard API endpoints
Change Honey Key request handling
Change background scan job behavior
For payload shape see dashboard-payload; for report/docs HTML see dashboard-pages; for the scan path see scan-orchestrator

modules.purpose: Application-layer scan pipeline. Home of scan_repo, the single append-only scan path the CLI, MCP server, and dashboard all drive, plus the parser/profile resolution it needs to stand alone. Split out of cli.py so non-CLI subsystems no longer import the command-line entry point, breaking the cli <-> dashboard_server import cycle.
common_changes: Change the scan pipeline or its ordered stages
Adjust scan profile or parser resolution
Add an enrichment or correlation step to a scan

modules.purpose: Dashboard UI-payload assembly (the /api/summary body). Turns raw storage rows into the per-repo UI payload via set-based batch reads and embeds the live scanner/tool/pack catalogs. Lifted out of ObservatoryDB so persistence no longer imports scanner orchestration; output is byte-for-byte identical to the pre-split payload.
common_changes: Change the /api/summary payload shape
Adjust per-repo batch assembly or catalog embedding
Add a new data kind to the dashboard summary
Change per-repo rotation enrichment (enrich_repos_with_rotation)

modules.purpose: Server-rendered report and docs HTML pages: the /report/ export (AI-handoff prompt + full raw report) and the /docs/ shell. Pure functions that take a scan/doc payload and return a string, keeping dashboard_server a routing layer rather than a second templating engine.
common_changes: Edit the /report/ export page
Edit the /docs/ shell rendering
Change category labels or report HTML

modules.purpose: Canonical case-lifecycle state machine: the single source of truth for case states (open, verified, in_progress, accepted_risk, resolved), the stored decision statuses, and the MCP presentation mapping. decisions.py, cases.py, storage.py (the CHECK constraint), and mcp_server.py all derive their state vocabulary from here instead of carrying divergent enums.
common_changes: Add or rename a lifecycle or decision state
Change the stored-decision to presentation-state mapping
Adjust the storage CHECK-constraint state vocabulary

modules.purpose: React/Vite dashboard source for the local browser UI.
common_changes: Edit dashboard views and components
Adjust TypeScript dashboard data mapping
Update visual styling or assets

modules.purpose: macOS appify-style desktop wrapper, icon generation, install, and process cleanup scripts.
common_changes: Change app bundle metadata
Refresh icons
Adjust launch/quit behavior
Rebuild or reinstall the local app bundle

modules.purpose: Human-facing setup, architecture, scanner, troubleshooting, desktop launcher, and Honey Key documentation.
common_changes: Update setup or troubleshooting notes
Document scanner behavior
Keep desktop launcher reports current

modules.purpose: Guarded MCP write adapter: read-only devsec-mcp plus devsec-mcp-rw, which adds case-resolution apply, a rate-limited local rescan, and the propose -> clean-room-review -> land code-fix flow.
common_changes: Add or adjust a guarded write-mode MCP tool
Change the case-resolution validation or decision mapping
Adjust the fix-proposal / clean-room-review / land lifecycle
Tune the trigger_scan rate limit or profile allowlist
